objective.primaryRule: reference method NL0: each track's primary = the actual-profit role of its qualified C24 members; the study's nominee = the actual-profit role of the C24 final selectable set (every track's qualified members and the controls New L0 under the 8 toggle combinations, C4, C4-refined, C85): the highest development centre net among qualified members (gates Q1-Q6; the fresh confirmation decides qualification), ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label; fold primaries (C19, C21, C23) = each fresh track's actual-profit role (PROTOCOL.md §9).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres; refinement moves apart): B1 and B2 each 131,072 base / 262,144 maximum per cutoff x 4 cutoffs; A1 about 60,000 base / 103,000 maximum; A2 about 56,500 / 101,000 (C24); <= 1,165,076 base / <= 2,301,152 maximum. Backend evaluations: the per-job caps (NL0's per-lane contract scaled by lanes: 23,056 per independent lane, 61,667 per informed lane; 700 per qualified member; phase 2 60,000; ablation 120,000; diagnostics 40,000; validation neighbourhoods 30,000; engineering 400,000) sum to about 23.85 M (worst case); expected about 17 M. Against Priority 3B: 131,072 independent base per cutoff and 4,869,671 independent search + 285,368 qualification evaluations (5,834,395 whole study); B1 and B2 each target about 5.9 M search + 0.8 M qualification evaluations. Counted separately: screen, rung-1/2/3 and refinement centres and neighbours, qualification, folds, sequential, ablation, diagnostics, validation, retries (runs.jsonl) and archive hits.
